tasks.description:

tasks.subject: Task 1: Add financial planning loop to Shopify sync
tasks.description:
**Goal:** After each Shopify sync, automatically call `generate_job_financial_plan` for every order line that has an active BOM, so the detail page can show planned margin without manual action.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/lib/shopify/sync.ts` (add planning loop; add `planRuns` to `SyncResult`)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `SyncResult` type includes `planRuns: number`
- [ ] After each sync, `job_cost_snapshot` rows are created for lines with active BOMs
- [ ] Errors in financial planning do not throw — each line continues silently
- [ ] `getWeekStart` imported from `@/lib/dates`

**Verify:** `npm run build` → no type errors

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/lib/shopify/sync.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm run build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["SyncResult type includes planRuns: number", "After each sync, job_cost_snapshot rows are created for lines with active BOMs", "Errors in financial planning do not throw", "getWeekStart imported from @/lib/dates"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Build getOrderLineStatus helper
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create a tested shared helper that fetches BOM + component + stock data per order line in batched queries, returning an `OrderLineStatus` map the detail page can use directly.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/orders/order-line-status.ts`
- Create: `src/lib/orders/order-line-status.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `deriveAllocationState` returns `no-bom` when bom is null
- [ ] `deriveAllocationState` returns `empty-bom` when bom exists but componentCount is 0
- [ ] `deriveAllocationState` returns `allocated` when bom exists and componentCount > 0
- [ ] `getOrderLineStatus` returns a Map keyed by lineId
- [ ] All 4 tests pass

**Verify:** `npm test -- src/lib/orders/order-line-status.test.ts` → 4 tests pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/lib/orders/order-line-status.ts", "src/lib/orders/order-line-status.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm test -- src/lib/orders/order-line-status.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["deriveAllocationState returns no-bom when bom is null", "deriveAllocationState returns empty-bom when bom exists but componentCount is 0", "deriveAllocationState returns allocated when bom exists and componentCount > 0", "getOrderLineStatus returns a Map keyed by lineId", "All 4 tests pass"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Redesign order detail page
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace the current sidebar-heavy layout with a BOM-per-line design: summary stat cards at top, one card per order line showing BOM version + component table + collapsed labor, planning sidebar removed entirely.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/app/app/orders/[orderId]/page.tsx`
- Modify: `src/app/app/orders/[orderId]/page.module.css`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Planning controls sidebar removed
- [ ] 4 summary stat cards rendered (order value, planned margin, lines allocated, labor scheduled)
- [ ] Each line card shows: product title, status badge, SKU/qty/price/BOM link
- [ ] Component table visible (BOM name + reserved qty + available badge) when BOM exists
- [ ] Amber warning card shown for no-bom / empty-bom lines
- [ ] Labor section collapsed by default using `<details>/<summary>`
- [ ] "Re-run allocation" button in header triggers `allocateOrder` action
- [ ] `npm run build` passes

**Verify:** `npm run build` → no errors; manually verify detail page renders correctly
